challenges.title: The Dry Summer
challenges.brief: No rain since spring. The soil can carry far less grass this season — keep every species alive through the drought.

events.label: Drought
events.message: Drought — the soil can carry only half as much grass.

events.label: Late heat
events.message: Late heat — the dry spell returns, softer this time.

challenges.tip: Fewer rabbits eat less grass. A gentle hand now saves the foxes later.

challenges.title: Empty Sky
challenges.brief: The old nesting pines were cut, and the hawks left. You are the top predator now — the rabbits do not know that.

events.label: Hawks leave
events.message: The nesting pines are gone — the hawks have left the meadow.

events.label: Hawks return
events.message: New nest boxes went up — two young hawks return.

challenges.tip: Without hawks the rabbits grow fast — thin them before the grass pays for it.

challenges.title: Shrinking Reeds
challenges.brief: A drain was cut upstream and the reed bed lost ground. The whole marsh narrows from the bottom up.

events.label: The drain is cut
events.message: The drain was cut overnight — half the reed bed is gone.

events.label: Habitat loss
events.message: The marsh can carry less than half its reeds until the drain is closed.

challenges.tip: Half the reed bed is gone. Replant reeds, and trim the crowd to what the smaller marsh can feed.

challenges.title: Bumper Season
challenges.brief: Warm rains made the reeds explode — and the extra food is climbing the food chain toward the herons. Keep the boom inside the banks.

events.label: Warm rains
events.message: Warm rains — the reeds are growing half again as fast.

events.label: Herons arrive
events.message: Two travelling herons settle on the reed islands.

challenges.tip: Booms overshoot. Thin the hoppers while the reeds surge — the top of the chain follows with a lag.
